title: Unknown information object address analogue
purpose: Stress address-dependent handling by using a high fully encoded IOA inside a valid C_SC_NA_1 APDU.
expected_behavior: A receiver should parse the message fully and then either process, reject, or classify the object address as unknown without memory-safety issues.
constraints_preserved: APDU length 0x0e matches the following bytes exactly
TypeID 45 and one-object VSQ remain valid
IOA is fully encoded as 3 octets little-endian
No truncation or oversized count is introduced
issue_safety_notes: Targets the same semantic surface as unknown-IOA handling while avoiding any malformed body or exact crash replay.
